name: Tabs / Analytics Views
description: Analytics Views product scenario for the Tabs component.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled selected key. Unknown keys show no panel until they exist.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Mount-only selected key. Otherwise use the first enabled tab.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Axis of keyboard navigation and the tab list.

controls.name: activationMode
controls.description: Automatic activates on focus; manual requires a click, Space or Enter.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable tab navigation and header actions, retaining the visible panel.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Pill background or an underline that follows the selected tab's geometry.

controls.name: wrap
controls.description: Wrap the tab list instead of scrolling along its axis.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each tab; toggling preserves DOM and focus.

controls.name: actions
controls.description: Header controls outside tablist, such as New, Close selected, or More.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the selected enabled tab, or first enabled tab, once on mount.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name of the tablist, not the generic outer wrapper.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Visible heading IDs naming the tablist.

controls.name: aria-describedby
controls.description: Additional description IDs for the tablist.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Tab definitions. Each item supports value, label, content, disabled, panelId, leadingIcon, trailingIcon, and an optional overlay action via actionIcon, actionLabel, actionVisibility, actionPosition, and onAction.
